issues.description: In solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql (line 3) the JOIN to Gemeinde uses Freizeitpark.id (WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.id). In the rest of the solution repository the same conceptual foreign-key relationship to Gemeinde.schluessel consistently uses the column name <table>.gemeindeschluessel (for example solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql uses Zoo.gemeindeschluessel in its WHERE on line 3). Using Freizeitpark.id instead of Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel is an identifier-naming inconsistency for the same FK relationship and will confuse students about the correct column name to use when joining Freizeitpark to Gemeinde.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the WHERE clause in solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql to join on the consistently used foreign-key column name: WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel. Also update the template (and, if applicable, the Freizeitpark table schema in instructional materials) so both template and solution use Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel consistently, preventing confusion for students.
